_about: BL-323. Reviewed exceptions to scripts/check-csp.cjs. An entry matches one rule in one file on a line that contains `match`. It needs a reason. An entry that matches nothing fails the gate, so remove it when the code goes.

allow.why: The report preview shows the saved report (its own <style> block) in a sandboxed iframe. A srcdoc frame inherits the page policy, so under the desktop policy the report would show unstyled. Guided analysis is unlisted (owner decision D-2, docs/guided-unlisted.md), so no screen reaches this component and the Playwright run cannot open it. If guided analysis comes back, serve the preview from a URL of its own that carries its own policy (BL-555).
